design.complete_passage_plan: Author all N/E/S/W as full descriptions/conditionals with explicit subject/state ownership; every base and modified predicate contributes a proposition. Never score only the pairs.
new_assumptions: New incompatible family: dar=HOT and daiin=MOIST, predicates on a written subject/state.
One typed qo=NOT operation produces qodar and qodaiin.
NOT_HOT is not automatically COLD, nor NOT_MOIST automatically DRY. Binary exhaustive axes are a separate stronger assumption.
design.rival: qo denotes CORRECTS(property) as an intended regimen effect rather than negating a current property.
design.distinct_consequence: HOT(body) and NOT(HOT)(body) conflict at one state; prescribing correction of heat in a hot body does not. The moisture cell repeats this distinction independently.
design.falsifier: Both actual base cells must use the same operation. Fail if one needs negation and the other correction, or P and NOT(P) apply to the same subject/state without a written context distinction.
design.fitting_freedom: Two base meanings plus one shared constructor and explicit subject/state binders. Remaining whole forms unassigned. Old numeral/intensity daiin hypotheses remain unchanged in separate families.
design.smallest_step: Complete two rival four-block readings and inspect all four anchor pairs before a decoder; if impossible, keep the binding gap rather than claim a law test.
design.strongest_countercase: GDT812 ambiguities and structural wordbuilding do not prove qo semantics. This is a risky concrete trial, not confirmed morphology.
